venue_name: Miami-Dade County Court — Small Claims Division

forms.name: Statement of Claim (Small Claims)
forms.description: Florida Small Claims Rule Form 7.010. The primary small claims filing form.

steps.instruction: Complete the Statement of Claim form (Form 7.010).
File electronically via myflcourtaccess.com or in person at the Miami-Dade County Courthouse.
steps.note: E-filing is available and encouraged. In-person filing at 73 W. Flagler Street, Miami, FL 33130.

steps.instruction: Serve the defendant. Service can be by certified mail (clerk handles), sheriff, or process server.
Attend pre-trial mediation. Florida requires mediation before trial in small claims cases.
steps.note: Mediation is typically free or low-cost. If mediation doesn't resolve the case, it goes to trial.

steps.instruction: If mediation fails, attend the trial. Bring all documents, photos, and evidence organized.

service_of_process.method: Certified mail (clerk handles), sheriff, or process server

filing_instructions.hearing_info: Pre-trial mediation first, then trial if needed. Total timeline typically 60-90 days.

fees.fee_waiver_form: Application for Determination of Civil Indigent Status

mediation_info: Florida requires pre-trial mediation in small claims cases. Mediation is typically conducted by a county mediator at no cost to the parties. If both parties agree to a resolution in mediation, it becomes a binding agreement. If not, the case proceeds to trial.

statute_of_limitations.description: 5 years for written contract; 4 years for oral contract.
